clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram, the ring of the city's rulers has surfaced again after millennia beneath the sea. The naga now hold it, and Talen seeks the key to an ancient statuette.

Before the Well of Eternity collapsed, Zoram stood on Kalimdor's western coast as a jewel of the night elven empire. Its rulers wore the Ring of Zoram, whose inner band bears a strange code in the night elven language. The Great Sundering shattered the continent ten thousand years ago, and the ring sank with the city beneath the tides. It lies beneath the waters of what is now the Zoram Strand.

For millennia, silt and ruins hid the ring. Then naga began scouring Ashenvale's coast, and Ruuzel, a naga leader who dwells on an islet off the northern strand, uncovered it among the sunken debris. The night elf scholar Talen seeks the ring for more than its age. It is the only key that can unlock relics salvaged from the depths, including ancient statuettes sealed on the sea floor.
